scope:
Conditional catcher service interfaces through the fixed-family plant ledger.

Actual pulse rate and dispatch remain unchanged. Radiator temperature, conversion,
support, spare, factory and heat-exchanger accounts are re-solved. Component mass,
idle power and heat-leak values are explicit acceptance targets, not a completed
hot-pump design. The archived selected plant and its solver remain unchanged.

refrigerator_fraction_Carnot.criterion: Electrical work to provide the specified5K loads with200K ultimate rejection, conditional on large industrial helium refrigeration and the separately stated optical/cycle loads.
refrigerator_fraction_Carnot.basis: CERN-ATS-2013-004 official indexed primary report gives230W/W at4.5K,28.5percentofCarnot. The central value and interval are research judgments for this future architecture, not a measured5K/200K apparatus or a consequence of manufacturing efficiency.
refrigerator_fraction_Carnot.access: Official indexed fulltext passage checked; direct repository fetch reported blocked by parent.

uncertainty.other_parameters: Performance requirements and deterministic sensitivities. No probability or narrow credible interval assigned to the full hot pump, the cap routing or source capsule hardware.

scenario_status: Conditional fixed-rate interface sensitivities. 300kg/m2 is a new-service allocation, not a BOM. Warm buffer heat leakage uses the actual-dispatch conduit calculation; .13W/m2 booster input, 1W/m2 ambient pumping and .5W/m2 bearing/support bypass remain component acceptance targets. No row replaces selected-plant/point.json.

plant.scope: Conditional stationary heat/power/mass requirements. Hot eligibility, insulation, converter/HX/pump ratings and cold-sky view require hardware qualification. Original generic services retained; named HX and pump hardware are incremental allocations.
plant.surface_proxy_scope: Sum of separate maxima in constant-property carbon; prompt mathematical-surface deposition is an intentionally conservative reference, not a qualified physical temperature. Finite spectral penetration and delayed heat require separate treatment.
plant.processing_cost_scope: These named H-processing loads are compared with the retained ordinary-auxiliary allowance; they are not additional debits on top of an allowance already intended to cover processing. New requirements exceeding that allowance must be added explicitly.
plant.qualification: Conditional integrated accounting point. Source formation, receiver recovery and guide/thermal hardware remain engineering candidates.
